terra.problem: Saying the city won't fit inside any wall goes beyond the stated reason: the multitude of men and livestock.
The line about counting the second wall doesn't make logical sense as a joke.
The passage doesn't say there will be too many residents for a wall.
The passage doesn't say the city will be too crowded for walls to hold it.
The drawer joke doesn't establish that Papa lived in a junk drawer, context a baker may not know.
The eye-poking joke plays on the reference to God's eye rather than keeping the humor on the human side.
The passage says they will know then, not that the knowing comes immediately after the plundering.
Saying the knowing comes right after the turn adds timing the passage doesn't give.
The claim that rivals don't join anybody's side is confusing and doesn't help explain the verse.
The passage says many nations will join themselves to the LORD. It doesn't say nobody is dragged in.
